questions.question: What is the occasion of Psalm 56?
options: When Saul pursued David in the wilderness
When the Philistines seized David in Gath
When Absalom rose up against his father
When the Ziphites betrayed David to Saul
questions.answer: When the Philistines seized David in Gath

questions.question: What does David say he will not fear?
options: What his enemies whisper in secret
What the future may yet hold
What flesh (man) can do to him
What the nations plot against him
questions.answer: What flesh (man) can do to him

questions.question: David says God keeps count of his tossings and puts his tears in a bottle.
When I am afraid, I put my _____ in you.
In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I shall not be _____.
